title: Evening triage war-room prep — Customer X latency spike
body:
Purpose:
- Quick prep ahead of 19:00 war-room with Customer X (enterprise account, Dedicated cluster).
- Primary objective: stabilize tail-latency spikes, identify root cause (config vs model vs infra), agree rollback/fallback plan, and draft customer-facing update.

Current state (as of 18:30):
- Symptom: 95th/99th percentile token latency increased ~2.5x over baseline around 15:12 UTC. Error rate small (~0.3%) but timeouts rising for heavy prompt paths.
- Affected routes: /v1/chat.stream and /v1/generate with model variant redwood-3b-q4_2025.
- Scope: ~23% of Customer X traffic, predominantly long-sequence product-summary jobs.
- Capacity: Dedicated pool at 82% GPU utilization (p3* ratio); autoscale set to conservative (min 3, max 8).

Timeline (quick digest):
- 15:08: First increase in per-seq latency seen on dashboard (route-level).
- 15:12: Spike becomes sustained; concurrent token rate stable, but per-request latency climbs.
- 15:30: Pager on-call SRE alerted; initial THROUGHPUT steady => likely per-request compute issue (KV cache pressure or kernel selection).
- 16:05: Canary fallback rule (to quantized variant) did not trigger due to compatibility check failing.
- 17:15: Customer reported degraded UX; CS opened support channel.

Immediate goals for war-room (ordered):
1) Confirm whether problem is config (batching/seq-length), runtime (kernel/quantization), or infra (GPU descheduling / noisy neighbor).
2) If runtime/config: roll traffic to redwood-3b-q4_2025-fp16 or enable prefix caching for long-prompts as quick mitigation.
3) If infra: request rapid scale-up (add 2 GPUs) as temporary relief and enable fallback routing to eu-west region if latency acceptable.
4) Draft message to customer explaining: detected, investigating, mitigation steps, ETA for next update.
5) Action items with owners and ETA.

War-room checklist (quick runbook):
- Pre-meeting checks (do before 19:00):
  - Confirm latest dashboard snapshot (Console > Models > redwood-3b-q4_2025 > Time range 12:00-18:30). (Owner: Leah)
  - Collect kernel logs from node-3 & node-7 (last 6h). CLI: rwdctl nodes logs --node node-3 --since 6h > node3-kernel.log. (Owner: Diego)
  - Verify autoscaler events: rwdctl autoscale history --pool customer-x-dedicated. (Owner: Omar)
  - Snapshot running model variants and config: rwdctl model describe redwood-3b-q4_2025 --json > variant.json. (Owner: Omar)
- During war-room:
  - Share timeline and metrics (Leah)
  - Attempt controlled traffic shift: 10% -> redwood-3b-q4_2025-fp16, monitor 5min (SRE/Platform). (Owner: SRE on-call; backup: Diego)
  - If shift improves P95 by >30% and error rate stable => plan staged rollout (50% in 30m).
  - If shift fails or increases errors => revert and try region fallback.
  - Consider enabling prefix/KV cache: toggle via config flag on customer route for long prompts (Product/Platform).

Quick commands & queries to run (paste into Slack war-room channel):
- Token latency summary (1h): curl -s "https://console.redwood.ai/api/metrics?metric=token_latency&model=redwood-3b-q4_2025&range=1h" | jq .
- Active GC/kernel errors: grep -i "kernel" /var/log/inference/node-*/runtime.log | tail -n 200
- Autoscaler events: rwdctl autoscale history --pool customer-x-dedicated --since 24h | tail -n 50

Customer message template (short, to be reviewed by CS lead):
"Hi <Customer-X-POC>,
We detected increased latency affecting a portion of your requests starting ~15:12 UTC today. Our engineering team is actively investigating and testing mitigations (traffic to optimized variant, caching toggles). We’ll share a status update by 20:00 UTC and a plan for rollback/fallback if needed. Apologies for the disruption — we’re prioritizing stability and will keep you informed.
— Omar (Customer Success) & Redwood Engineering"

Internal escalation ladder & contacts (fast-dial):
- On-call SRE: Diego Martinez (pager: +1-555-0123)
- Infra eng: Leah Song (Slack @leah.song)
action_items: Omar: Consolidate pre-meeting artifacts and post summary to CS thread — due 19:30 2025-11-04
Leah: Gather dashboard screenshots and perf breakdown by route/variant — due 19:00 2025-11-04
Diego: Pull kernel logs and look for recent kernel selection failures / OOMs — due 19:15 2025-11-04
SRE-oncall: Execute 10% controlled shift to fp16 variant and report P95/P99 after 5m — due during war-room
Platform: Prepare quick scale-up (add 2 GPUs) if traffic shift does not help — standby
Product: Prepare config toggle to enable prefix caching for Customer X routes — ETA 2 hours if approved
CS Lead (Priya): Approve customer update and send at 20:00 UTC unless earlier blocker found
